posts.body:
HOW IT STARTED...
I created a website, actually to show off my real coins, which are mainly silver-plated unused €5 and €10 coins, or 50p coins from England. They all have memorable value, they are uncommon and some even rare. Like I have a silver plated €10 which was released as celebration for the Dutch king to be crowned in 2013, or a ƒ5.- (Dutch Guilders) from 2000 celebrating the European Championship soccer, and how about a British 50p coin, untouched and in brilliant quality (not far under proof) with the face of John Lennon?
Anyhow... Some of those coins, might be worth some money some day. And I was advices to not put those online. Right now the 50p John Lennon coin is worth maybe 20 bucks, if uncirculated. (Or you can still buy then directly from the British Royal Mint for about £18.50 British Pounds.) But one day, maybe 10 years from now, some of those coins might be real money, specially the ones that have a limited. And when I happen to get a real rare coin, which turns out to be a lot more money, then I shouldn't unknowingly put them online.
But I already created the website! I even used AI to generate a cool personalized coin, which I wanted to use some kind of logo or signature to the website. I would mark all my photo's with that coin, in the bottom right corner, and use it in the header and background of my website. (Luckily, since I live in Europe, this is now legally safe to do.)
ABOUT THAT COIN...
So, this is the golden coin I was talking about. It isn't the first draft, but it is the one I ended up using:
I simply asked AI to create a photo of me as a medieval king. Then I asked gemini to generate a medieval coin with this kinds portrait embossed on it. At first I got some roman words or a name on the edge, the coin was dark and hardly visible unless you looked at it at full screen.
I tweaked the prompt, asked for specific text and material of the coin. And the result is what you see here.
YOU GENERATED A COIN, SO WHAT?
So what? I thought it was awesome! Look at the result! Sure, you might not like the face, or the lach of text on the rest of the other ring... I would agree to one of those statements.
But you must admit, this looks like a pretty awesome coin as a logo for a website about coins. Right?
And once I like the result of something I've done, I want to do it again. And again, and again, and again. Especially as the results keep improving. And no, it is not the AI that improves, it is still the exact same Flash 2.5 version. My prompts in combination with the images I have the coins based on are improved. I got better in telling AI what to do.
(It sounds stupid, but it is what it is.)
By now, I created quite some coins. Including the one that is currently my avatar. And I like creating those coins. And I like to show those coins to everyone, even though they are completely fake and totally worthless and probably no-one even wants to see them.
SO NOW WHAT?
Now, I decided to start a series of coins. Inspired by the limited zilver-plated €5 coin, of which a new one is released every 6 months, honoring some kind of anniversary or current event, like 750 years Amsterdam, 200 years TT, or the crowning of King Willem Alexander.
I have started 2 series myself:
RPG maker Euro series
RPG maker themed Euro coins.
Head-side of a 1-euro coin with a custom design.
Comes out when someone in the RPG maker community allows me to make a coin about their brand.
Tail-side of the coin might be made, if RPG maker team would allow me to use RPG maker logo's. (Which I don't expect to happen, and I don't know who to ask.) Else I will use a back side with a JohnDoeNews logo.
Wildlife
Wildlife themes Euro coins.
Head-side of a 1-euro coin with a custom design.
Comes out once a month.
Tail-side of the coin will be released with the third coin, and will be released as an extra.
My coins are
fictional
and
virtual
. They are nothing else then a PNG, that resembles a coin. I even made up the term FVC (Fictional Virtual Coin) to make extra, extra clear that those coins are no real valuta, no images of existing coins, no crypto and no NFT.
WHY WOULD I WANT TO COLLECT THESE FVC'S?
Why? Because the FVC's look amazing! I already told you. They are nice collectables, if you're into collectables. At least I think so. And they are free. Even though you can't do anything with it.
Although... I do allow those coins to be used in game, or any project. But it is
very
important to realize that I used AI to put the designs on the coin!
Regulation differs per country, if there is any regulation at all‼
It is not what I made this series for, but I did, just in case, rescale each FVC to 144×144, 48×48, and 32×32. That being said, not every FVC is as recognizable in the 32×32 format, but combine it with the 144×144 format, and you have a nice collectable item for in any game.
WHY NOT PUT THE FORMATTED FVC ON THE FORUM?
Easy: Because AI not allowed. I mean, I am not allowed to share them as useable assets, when I make them with AI. And that is okay, I made actually made for myself and I posted them just to show off. But if anyone wants to use them, they can. (This goes for the ones posted on my website, not the golden FVC used in this post!)
WHERE CAN I FIND THOSE FVC'S?
Now you ask the right question!
https://coins.johndoenews.nl
So, why not JohnDoeGames? Because JohnDoeGames is for game related content and this isn't game related content. Well, maybe the RPG maker series is game related, JohnDoeGames has to be about my games. The RPG maker series, contains FVC's based on my game, but the series is about RPG maker games in general, not just about me.
CAN I HAVE AN FVC IN THE RPG MAKER EURO SERIES?
Probably. I am not just giving any Jack and Jill a FVC. Well-known devs and artists are more likely to get a coin in this collecten. This means being active here so we all know you, at least by name and avatar. A high activity count helps a lot (because that way you get yourself known by the community). But even if you're not very active here, you might still be known in the community. You'd still be a good subject for an FVC in this series. Maybe you have a cool game or assets posted elsewhere.
However... Even an unknown dev can take a stand. If you have a cool preview/demo and are about to release a game, your game might get an FVC after all. You have to earn it though, by showing me a demo that convinces me release is work celebrating.
Or maybe you have something else that makes you worthy of a coin.
Why? Why alone known community members? Because that is what collectors like to collect. And a collector favors his collection as much as he favors his least favorite piece. I would still love to help you generate a coin, I just won't release it in the series, if you are completely unknown. I hope you understand. (Edit: Like, if you joined the community 12 minutes ago, or your request is the 5th comment you've posted since you joined 3 years ago, then you are unknown. You don't have to be on TV or something.)
Oh and uhm... You need to have all rights to the assets you allow me to use on the FVC. This is also the case when you generate them yourself. Technically you are not allowed to upload your RTP, to have AI put it on an FVC, which you then you use in RPG maker... I think... IDK. So, I do
not
accept graphics from the medieval set unless you're PVGames, or the pop!horror set unless you're Vexed Enigma, etc etc. Which are two more names of artists I would love to put on a coin, but are not on the forums as far as I know.
Just leave a comment, and who knows?
